title: Process Technician 2 (TEMP-REQ-2026-0192)
description:
Kyocera has a temp-to-hire position for a Process Technician 2 at our San Diego, CA facility.

Candidates selected for hire will be hired through one of Kyocera’s approved staffing partners.

This position may lead to a direct hire offer with Kyocera International, Inc.

Pay is $19.50 per hour

With nearly 80,000 employees globally, Kyocera is a leading manufacturer of high-tech ceramics in various industries, including aerospace, automotive, medical applications, and semiconductor processing. Our innovative materials are found in everything from smartphones to space shuttles!


Exempt: No
Safety Sensitive: Yes

GENERAL DESCRIPTION OF POSITION

A Process Technician 2 performs a variety of functions associated with manufacturing operations, including working with engineers and operators in set-up and calibration tasks, as well as performing rework and quality testing related to the production of parts, components, subassemblies and final product. Uses programs to collect and evaluate operating data to conduct in-line adjustments to parts, instruments or equipment. Updates and may assist in developing methods and procedures to control or modify the manufacturing process.

REQUIREMENTS

High school diploma or GED required.
2+ years of technician experience required in a manufacturing/production environment.
Ability to read, write and comprehend instructions in English.
Ability to add, subtract, multiply, divide all units of measure including common and decimal fractions.
Ability to use a microscope, depending on the specific function.
Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision and depth perception.
20/20 corrected vision may be required - varies by division
Willingness to wear PPE (examples: goggle, gloves, apron, finger cot, masks, and/or cleanroom apparel.
Ability to grab small parts or hand tools with hands.
Eligible to work in an ITAR environment


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  1. Monitors and documents the operation of machines in a production environment. Maintains flow of production parts; reports inconsistencies, and suggests improvements in the production process.
  2. Troubleshoots complex or troublesome equipment, may work with facilities team or outside vendor or repair or modification.
  3. May run engineering tests prescribed by engineer. Perform periodic calibration checks.
  4. May recommend process improvements based on test and process results and experience. Troubleshoot machine set up.
  5. Visually inspects parts at required steps in the process with attention to detail, ensuring the parts are within specified tolerances. May disposition of reject parts and train operators and inspectors to improve efficiency.
  6. Maintains and orders/tracks tools according to safety and vendor recommendations. Will use measuring devices, such as micrometers, calipers, CMM and other optical tools.
  7. Participates in the 5S program.
  8. Knowledgeable of Excel and able to accurately enter data into spreadsheets and create graphs. Experience in basic CNC and CMM is helpful.
  9. Complies with applicable requirements of Kyocera International, Inc. policy, ISO 9000, ISO 14001 requirements, ITAR regulations.
  10. May setup/program production or test machinery.
  11. Reads specifications and mechanical drawings.
  12. May assign and check work of lower-level technicians and operators. Perform the duties or an operator or material handler on occasion as needed.

Perform any other related duties as required or assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty mentioned satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.


PHYSICAL ACTIVITIES
The following physical activities described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions and expectations.

While performing the functions of this job, the employee is continuously required to talk or hear; regularly required to stand, use hands to finger, handle, turn, twist, or feel; frequently required to walk, sit; and occasionally required to reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl.

The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds, frequently lift and/or move up to 25 pounds, regularly lift and/or move up to 10 pounds.

ENVIRONMENTAL CONDITIONS
The following work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the functions of this job, the employee is occasionally exposed to work near moving mechanical parts, work in high, precarious places, fumes or airborne particles.

The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
The above statements are intended to describe the work being performed by people assigned to this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required. The duties and responsibilities of this position are subject to change and other duties may be assigned or removed at any time.
This position may require exposure to information subject to US Export Control regulations, i.e.: the International Traffic and Arms Regulations (ITAR) or Export Administration Regulations (EAR). All applicants must be US persons within the meaning of US regulations.

Kyocera International, Inc. values diversity in its workforce, and is proud to be an AAP/EEO employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability.
If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are limited in the ability or unable to access or use this online application process and need an alternative method for applying, you may contact Kyocera International, Inc.'s Human Resources team directly.
Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

title: Director of Philanthropy - Boston & Providence
description:
How many people can answer the question, "What do you do for a living?" with the answer, "I help find cures for cancer." At Blood Cancer United, employees take our mission seriously. Whether you work in one of our regions, are an accountant at the national office or a specialist in our Information Resource Center, you work each day on making our bold goal a reality: to enable patients with blood cancer to gain more than one million years of life by 2040. Join us and give new meaning to the word, "job."

Summary: The Director of Philanthropy is a front-line fundraiser responsible for securing major gifts within a designated market. This role focuses on managing a portfolio of high-capacity donors and prospects to secure funding for our mission. The Director will implement strategic cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship activities to meet and exceed revenue goals, relentlessly pursuing cancer cures.

Core Responsibilities/ Primary Duties:

Portfolio Management & Major Gift Fundraising

    • Manage a portfolio of qualified major gift prospects, with a focus on donors capable of giving $10,000 or more.
    • Execute a comprehensive fundraising plan for the assigned portfolio, including specific strategies for donor cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship.
    • Accountable for achieving an annual revenue target by creating and implementing personalized fundraising strategies.
    • Conduct a significant number of meaningful donor interactions, including face-to-face visits, to advance relationships and secure gifts.
    • Prepare and present compelling proposals and materials for major gift solicitations.

Pipeline Development & Strategy Execution

    • In partnership with the Sr. Director, actively build and grow the major gift pipeline by identifying new prospects from various channels (e.g., events, direct mail, volunteer networks).
    • Utilize internal analytics and research tools to qualify prospects and develop strategic engagement plans.
    • Collaborate with national partners to identify opportunities for Principal Gifts, Planned Giving, and Foundation support within the portfolio.
    • Ensure timely and accurate tracking of all donor interactions and pipeline movement in Salesforce.

Collaboration & Mission Advancement

    • Partner with Executive Directors, regional staff, and volunteer leaders to identify donor prospects and create a seamless donor experience.
    • Serve as a knowledgeable and passionate representative of the mission, effectively communicating our impact and funding priorities to donors.
    • Participate in mission-centered cultivation events and activities to engage prospects and donors.
    • Maintain a working knowledge of the Blood Cancer United mission and programs to promote organizational initiatives.
    • Perform other related duties as assigned.

#LI-Hybrid

Minimum Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s Degree required.
  • 5-7+ years of fundraising experience, with a demonstrated track record of success in individual major gift fundraising.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Experience managing a portfolio of donors, including personally identifying, cultivating, and soliciting five- and six-figure gifts.
  • Proficiency in Salesforce or similar CRM database.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Work Environment & Physical Demands:

  • Local and regional travel up to 40% of the time.
  • Periodic weekend and evening work required.
  • Physical demands are minimal and typical of similar jobs in comparable organizations.
  • Work environment is representative and typical of similar jobs in comparable organizations.

Employee Value Proposition:
As a valued member of Blood Cancer United, you are eligible for a comprehensive benefits package. Our offerings include medical, dental, and vision insurance; life insurance; flexible spending accounts; a 403b retirement plan along with generous paid time off. In addition, we observe federal paid holidays throughout the year, and offer a wellness program and an employee assistance program.

We are excited to share the base pay range for this position is $97K to $122K. The offered compensation may vary based on factors such as geographic location, business need, market conditions, proficiencies, skills, education, and experience. Additionally, at Blood Cancer United we place a high value on internal pay equity and will consider the current compensation of similarly situated roles and direct team members. Base compensation is only one component of our Total Rewards program, which also includes an annual incentive plan and a competitive benefits package.

The statements herein are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees, and are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties, and skills required of employees. Furthermore, they do not establish a contract for employment and are subject to change at the discretion of the Company. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Disclaimer

title: Producer I, Social (FinLit)
description:
Position Summary:

Marketplace is looking for a creative social media producer who can create those scroll-stopping moments for our portfolio of financial literacy programs and help bring our economic journalism to new audiences.

We are the most widely heard suite of business shows in the country, reaching more than 10 million people on air, online, and on demand. Our financial literacy portfolio includes award-winning kids podcast “Million Bazillion” and award-winning money and relationships podcast “This Is Uncomfortable,” among others.

The ideal candidate is someone who can produce and execute innovative social content. You must have sharp social copywriting, video editing, graphic design, and fact-checking skills. You’ll optimize Marketplace content in a dynamic way across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, Bluesky, and emerging social platforms. You have strong instincts for short-form video and visual design. And you have demonstrated success in creating campaigns and content that resonate with diverse audiences.

*This is a grant-funded, two-year role.

This position sits in the collective bargaining agreement between Marketplace and Screen Actors Guild—American Federation of Television and Radio Artists (“SAG-AFTRA”).

Expected Compensation Range: $41.62 - $49.94 per hour. The exact salary rate is determined by experience and education related to the role, organizational compensation structure, and internal equity.

Location: Remote

Application Process: Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

Application Deadline: Open until filled.

Position Responsibilities:

  • Write and produce highly shareable social-first content on tight deadlines, including short-form videos and graphics, for all social platforms.
  • Identify stories, moments and ideas from Marketplace’s financial literacy programs that can translate into compelling social content.
  • Help develop original social videos, including researching ideas, writing scripts, shaping hooks and selecting clips.
  • Write and edit social copy, headlines, captions, scripts and other audience-facing language.
  • Strategically schedule and publish content across all social platforms.
  • Analyze social performance and produce regular campaign and content reports.
  • Work collaboratively with reporters, producers and hosts.
  • Use data to inform how and what we post.
  • Stay up-to-date and ahead of the curve on social media best practices.
  • Ensure consistent voice and branding across our social platforms.
  • Help cultivate and develop conversations between our audience, hosts and reporters.

Required Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Journalism or related field required.
  • 5+ years experience producing content for social platforms on behalf of a brand or media outlet.
  • Familiarity with financial literacy content and social media trends in the FinLit space, with an understanding of how creators and organizations are engaging audiences around economic topics.

Required Skills, Knowledge and Abilities:

  • Self-starter with excellent editorial judgment and an understanding of journalistic standards.
  • Deep interest in how economic news intersects with people’s lives.
  • Demonstrated success producing engaging social content for a newsroom, media organization, publication or other editorial environment.
  • Strong knowledge of social media trends and best practices, including video-first platforms such as YouTube and TikTok
  • Superb social copywriting and fact-checking skills.
  • Proficient in Photoshop, Premiere, CapCut, Davinci Resolve or similar editing software
  • A team player who is accountable, proactive, and solution-oriented
  • Have strong instincts for content that social audiences find engaging.
  • Ability to work effectively with minimal supervision.
  • Ability to successfully meet deadlines and handle multiple responsibilities on a consistent basis.
  • Superior communication, organizational and collaborative skills.
  • Experience using social analytics and audience insights.
  • Responsible for developing and owning the social strategy for the fin-lit porftolio.
  • Ability to appear on camera or directing/editing on-camera video as needed.

Preferred Skills and Experience:

  • Experience using Sprout Social or similar social media programs (Hootsuite, Buffer, Later, etc.)
  • Familiarity with public media and Marketplace’s approach to economic journalism.

Reporting to this Position:

  • None

Physical Demands and Working Conditions:

  • Must be able to perform the essential duties of the position with or without reasonable accommodation.
  • Physical Demands:
    • Required to move about in an office environment and sit at extensive periods of time
    • Reach with hands and arms
    • Balance, stoop, kneel, or crouch
    • Frequent use of hands for data entry/keystrokes and simple grasping
  • Working Conditions:
    • Moderate noise level

description:
Seafood Clerk

Status: This is a non-exempt position.

Essential Knowledge

* Completion of ongoing training and development as listed on the Cosentino Learning Plan.
Non-Essential Knowledge

Skills

* Follow all guidelines for proper techniques of cutting and/or preparing items for placement in the display cases.
* Monitor all product expiration dates and ensure that all items are properly rotated.

Essential Abilities
* Reaching overhead with both arms up to a maximum of 72 inches, twisting at the waist and lifting objects with both hands weighing up to 30 lbs.
* Pushing and pulling grocery items to the proper locations as needed, up to a peak force of 20 lbs.
* Standing and walking for long periods of time on tile, asphalt, concrete or other hard surfaces.
* Occasionally lifting and carrying up to 50 lbs.
* Bending and squatting, at times all the way to floor level.
* Able to work in colder conditions of the grocery coolers and freezers.
Non-Essential Abilities
* Climbing a ladder, possibly up to 5ft.

title: Manager of Trade Shows and Events
description:
Manager, Tradeshows & Events
Location: Amherst, NY

Ivoclar has been a leader in dentistry for more than a century and is one of the world’s leading dental companies. Through our integrated solutions, we help improve oral health around the world. Everything we do is connected by one shared mission: Making People Smile.

We are seeking a highly organized, results-driven Manager, Tradeshows & Events to join our collaborative North America Marketing team. In this role, you will lead the planning and execution of live and virtual tradeshows, sales meetings, and special events while developing strategies that strengthen the Ivoclar brand, increase engagement, and support our sales and marketing objectives.

Salary Range: $80,000-$105,000 annually, depending on experience, qualifications, and location. Final compensation will be determined during the interview process.

Your Responsibilities

  • Plan, coordinate, and execute all aspects of live and virtual tradeshows and events, including major industry tradeshows, regional events, roadshows, lab meetings, sales meetings, and special events.
  • Develop event strategies that drive booth traffic, customer engagement, lead generation, and brand awareness.
  • Manage tradeshow and event logistics from initial planning through execution, including vendor coordination, shipping, exhibit materials, booth inventory, and onsite activities.
  • Negotiate vendor contracts and maintain strong relationships with external partners to ensure successful event execution.
  • Manage and maintain corporate tradeshow inventory to ensure materials are available and ready for upcoming events.
  • Partner with Regional Sales Managers, Territory Sales Managers, Marketing Managers, and other internal stakeholders to coordinate sales meetings and event programs.
  • Collaborate with Sales and Marketing teams on pre-show promotions, booth messaging, product demonstrations, promotions, and event staffing strategies.
  • Plan and coordinate special events, including key opinion leader events and internal sales meetings.
  • Support product demonstrations, social media activities, and other marketing initiatives associated with tradeshows and events.
  • Use social media and digital marketing strategies to increase event awareness and attendance, analyze results, and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Measure and analyze event and promotional results to help improve customer acquisition, retention, and overall program effectiveness.
  • Research emerging event technologies, communication tools, and event-planning platforms to identify opportunities to enhance the attendee and customer experience.
  • Manage departmental priorities, budgets, forecasts, and resources to support business objectives and efficient operations.
  • Recruit, onboard, train, develop, and manage employees as applicable, including performance management and development activities.
  • Foster a safe, inclusive, collaborative, and compliant work environment.
  • Support Ivoclar’s quality management system and adhere to the company’s Code of Conduct.

Your Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required; concentration in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field preferred.
  • Approximately 5 years of experience in marketing, sales, tradeshow management, event planning, or a related area preferred.
  • Previous tradeshow planning, logistics, and shipping experience required.
  • Experience with exhibit displays and event marketing is a plus.
  • Strong organizational and project-management skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to effectively manage multiple priorities and adapt quickly in a fast-paced, changing environment.
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Ability and willingness to travel as required to support tradeshows, meetings, and events.

Why Join Ivoclar?

  • Be part of a global leader with a legacy of innovation in dentistry.
  • Lead impactful marketing strategies that drive business growth.
  • Collaborate with talented professionals across North America and around the world.
  • Make a meaningful contribution to improving oral health and supporting dental professionals.

If you are looking for a career where you can contribute actively, develop personally and professionally and make a lasting difference then this is the right place for you. As an international family business with a long-term perspective, we know that it is our 3500 employees that are the key to our success. Let's achieve our goal together: Making people smile.

Ivoclar is committed to Equal Employment Opportunity and, as such, affirms in policy and practice to recruit, hire, train, and promote, in all job classifications, without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, citizenship, sex, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other protected characteristic. Ivoclar will not discriminate against persons because of their disability and will make reasonable accommodations for known physical or mental limitations of qualified employees and applicants with disabilities. We will also make reasonable accommodation during the interview and selection process.

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis. This position is not eligible for employer-based visa sponsorship now or in the future.

title: Central Utility Plant (CUP) Manager
description:
Job Summary:

Provides management expertise and oversight in the operation, maintenance, and repair of the central utility plant (CUP). Manage CUP and supporting department’s workload activities and employees, provide guidance to the O&M team in the preventative maintenance, operations, engineering systems improvements, equipment replacement, utilities usage, and long-term efficiency.

The CUP Manager serves as a supervisor over a plant operations and repair team. The CUP Manager provides the necessary on-site leadership skills to support a team encountering unique operating or repair problems. Tours areas, analyzes reports, and begins developing solutions before the problems escalate. Maintains a high level of cleanliness within the utility plant, keeping all equipment and spaces in a pristine, survey/ inspection ready state. Develops performance standards, counsels’ employees on performance, and makes formal and informal performance appraisals. The CUP Manager shall report directly to the PM/CMM or Assistant PM/CMM. The CUP Manager shall oversee the HVAC Supervisor and coordinate and work closely with the COR and facility management staff. The manager shall be able to direct, monitor, and oversee contractor staff necessary to execute all operations and maintenance requirements and quality control as described in this SOW and IAW established regulatory requirements. The manager develops and maintains vendor and supplier relationships to facilitate timely support when system repairs are required.

Primary Job Functions:

  • Familiarity with applicable HVAC, OSHA, NFPA/ASME, and ANSI/NEMA codes and standards

  • Demonstrated ability to direct, monitor, and oversee staff performing CUP operations, maintenance, and quality control

  • Responsible for execution of all CUP operations and maintenance requirements at building 3028

  • Effectively manages maintenance operations necessary to execute all scheduled maintenance and unscheduled maintenance events described in the project work scope with established regulatory requirements.

  • Responsible for assigning work orders and duties and reviewing all corrective and preventative maintenance for proper documentation.

  • Investigate equipment failures and issues to diagnose faulty operation, and to make recommendations to project manager, O&M team and FM staff.

  • Manages and supervise work orders to ensure timely, accurate, and effective completion.

  • Solicits bids for Service Contracts for Maintenance work and oversees timely completion.

  • Serves as the preventative and corrective maintenance expert for the team to come to for guidance and direction.

  • Ensures conformance to contract requirements and reviews performance indicators to improve efficiency.

  • Analyzes monthly actions to include labor, expenditures, overtime and collaborates with the management team on areas of improvement. Assist management team with communication between staff and the customer.

  • Ensures building files, drawings and maintenance records are kept up to date

  • Performs frequent Quality Control (QC) inspections, initiates, overseas, and documents corrective and preventative actions in support of the QC program.

  • Plans, manages, directs, and motivates assigned personnel and long-range activities, and ensures all programs and procedures are being properly implemented.

  • Responsible for on-the-job and ongoing training for all maintenance employees.

  • Responsible for parts and materials needed for on-time maintenance, coordinates requisitions with the Purchasing Department.

  • Prepare monthly reports assigned; review assigned service orders monthly to determine percent complete in order to invoice the government.

  • Perform over-the-shoulder inspections and help maintain a safe work environment.

Education, Experience and Certification:

Required: High School Diploma or equivalent

Required: The CUP Manager shall have 8 years of healthcare experience performing duties at a similarly sized facility which included the operation, maintenance and repair of power generation equipment, boiler, heating, refrigeration, ventilation including the operation and maintenance of air conditioning systems involving the use of automatic controls equipment. The CUP Manager shall be familiar with LEED building standards, ASHRE 170, NFPA 110, UFC 3-401-01, UFC 4-510-01CDC, environmental compliance and have experience in at least two (2) Joint Commission hospital surveys.

Preferred: Technical or trade certificates in related field.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Knowledge of the proper repair and maintenance requirements for medical facilities, grounds and utilities.

title: Surgery Scheduler (General Surgery)
description:

Austin Regional Clinic has been voted a top Central Texas employer by our employees for over 15 years! PURPOSE

Schedules surgeries for physicians at local surgery centers and hospitals. Creates and maintains surgery schedules for physicians. Obtains insurance authorizations and verifies benefits. Carries out all duties while maintaining compliance and confidentiality and promoting the mission and philosophy of the organization.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

  • Coordinate with physician and clinical team to schedule patient surgeries at local surgery centers and hospitals, pre op, and post op appointments.

  • Request estimates from financial counselor, anesthesia, and facility for patients cost of surgery.
  • Initiate charity process with hospital or surgery center for uninsured patients when applicable.
  • Review patient history and medications to insure accuracy in EPIC and verify medical and or specialist clearance prior to surgery.
  • Make outgoing calls in a timely manner to patients that need to schedule a procedure, and check voicemails frequently to return patient calls.
  • Assist other surgery schedulers as needed.
  • Adheres to all company policies, including but not limited to, OSHA, HIPAA, compliance and Code of Conduct.
  • Regular and dependable attendance.
  • Follows the core competencies set forth by the Company, which are available for review on CMSweb.
  • Works holiday shift(s) as required by Company policy.

OTHER DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Assist front desk and business office staff as needed.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education and Experience

Required: High school diploma or GED. Experience working in a medical office setting.

Preferred: Three (3) or more years of experience working in a surgical setting, to include surgery scheduling.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Knowledge of ICD and CPT coding methodology.
  • Ability to engage others, listen and adapt response to meet others’ needs.
  • Ability to align own actions with those of other team members committed to common goals.
  • Excellent computer and keyboarding skills, including familiarity with Windows.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities.
  • Ability to perform job duties in a professional manner at all times.

title: PCB Design Specialist
description:
The PCB Design Specialist designs and develops complex detailed layouts of printed circuit boards. Collaborates in developing state-of-the-art designs of new or modified, RF printed circuit boards. Establishes design standards and configurations. Works from preliminary schematics, part lists and basic description of the board function, configuration and arrangement as defined by engineering. May perform the checking of design layouts and detailed drawings. This position is remote. Legal authorization to work in the US is required.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Create PCB/PCBA design using Altium software with input from both mechanical and electrical
  • Create schematics and modify as directed by engineers.
  • Able to create library symbols/ footprint/3D drawing for component used
  • Study PCB design trends and processes and then evaluate and implement those processes that apply to Ezurio.
  • Conduct design feasibility studies to evaluate the PCB design goals for packaging, cost, manufacturing, and system performance.
  • Perform complex and difficult CAD and CAE tasks requiring extensive skill and knowledge of equipment capabilities, applications techniques and design limitations.
  • Ensure PCBs are designed to observe the principle of design for test (DFT) and design for manufacturability (DFM).
  • Propose PCB design trade-offs to the engineering design team for resolution and implementation.
  • Communicate with fabrication vendors for quotations and purchase requisitions also responsible to engineering questions (EQ) from PCB fabricators.
  • Understands the requirements for a quality design and strives to achieve the requirements before releasing the product to manufacturing.
  • Understands the impedance control requirement of the different electrical bus interfaces and RF circuits, familiar with the basic rule of thumb to achieve SI (Signal Integrity) during the routing.
  • Understands the driving of PCB technology and process trends and their application to Ezurio's designs.
  • Coordinate with Engineering, Test, Quality, and Manufacturing during the PCB design and fabrication process.
  • Resolve PCB design issues with fabrication and manufacturing vendors.
  • Participate and provide input into the PCB design specifications and standards with respect to product design, electrical design, manufacturing and various regulatory agency requirements to determine design trade-offs necessary to meet design goals and produce high quality PCB's at the lowest cost and within schedule.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Demonstrate proficient hands-on use of Altium Designer for PCB layout, library management, and PCB design release. Experience with Cadence or Mentor PCB design tools is a plus.
  • Ability of using Mechanical CAD tools like Solidwork/AutoCad is preferred.
  • Must demonstrate an ability to read schematics
  • Proficient working knowledge of PCB design best practices and applicable IPC standards, including IPC-2221, IPC-7351, IPC-A-600, and IPC-6012. Knowledge of IPC-A-610 is also preferred.
  • Demonstrated strong and effective verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelors or Technical Degree and a minimum of 5 years related experience required
  • Experience in RF Circuit PCB design is preferred

Ezurio recognizes that an individual with a disability may require accommodation to enable them to successfully perform a job function. Should you require such accommodation, please indicate the job function and suggested accommodation. Ezurio will attempt to make reasonable accommodation.

Position Title: Groundman

Our Core Values: Guided by Safety. Focused on Communities. Powered by Care.

Essential Functions:

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

The Groundman assists line crew or network crew members by working on the ground, handing tools and heavy materials to workers. The groundman will dig holes and pad ditches, and perform other similar work in connection with the construction and maintenance of overhead and underground power lines.

  • Groundmen are never permitted to work on energized conductors without direct/immediate supervision at all times.
  • A Groundman is also responsible for his/her own safety at all times and is expected to learn and follow all company guidelines and safety procedures.
  • It is the responsibility of the groundman to report any and all accidents to the Foreman immediately and to make the Foreman aware of any known potential safety hazards that may exist.
  • Safety should be the number one priority of any groundman and ensure the safety of his fellow crew members by following all safety guidelines

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Passes tools to line crew or network crew members by acting as a general helper on the ground. Handles cables, conduit and other materials as directed. Glues conduits together. Assists in setting transformers.

  • Clears undergrowth from right-of-way by using hand tools or saws. Piles debris clear path.
  • Performs general clean-up of job sites following completion of work.
  • Positions reels of electric cable beside trenches and lays heavy residential underground distribution (URD) cables in ditches and pads by shoveling fine sand around cable.
  • Assists network crew top man with lowering and raising molten metals and other heavy materials to the cable splicer working below in the vault.
  • Operates roto hammer to access vaults.
  • Notifies customers of impending disruption of service while lines are under repair.
  • Flags traffic to protect employees and the public from injury.
  • May assist as directed in operating jackhammer or digging bars to break concrete or rocks.
  • May drive 3/4-ton or 1-ton pickup truck to job site or to obtain supplies.
  • Performs other duties as assigned. Job duties are subject to change as directed by management

Success Factors:

  • Good Mechanical and Electrical Aptitude
  • Strong team player with the ability to adapt to diverse team members
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to perform heavy manual labor for extended periods, often under adverse climatic conditions.
  • Ability to lift up to 80 lbs multiple times during a work shift
  • Ability to climb, dig, work in tight spaces, on uneven surfaces, walking, stooping, and kneeling
  • Ability to understand and follow specific oral and written instructions
  • Ability to work well independently and as a part of a team with co-workers
  • Ability to pass motor vehicle, criminal background check, and comply with drug-free workplace policy
  • Willingness and ability to learn additional skills

Experience and Education:

  • Electricity Training Preferred
  • One (1) year of experience in a labor-intensive environment

Additional Requirements/Licenses/Certifications:

  • Possession of a valid State of Residence Class A CDL License is required.
  • Candidates must pass criminal and Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) background checks and pass a pre-employment drug screen.
  • Must complete OSHA 10hr Safety Training Program within 60 days, other combinations of education / experience may be considered.
  • Must have ability for frequent travel on needed training requirements and potential for overtime including storm work.
  • Physical capabilities required to safely operate a motor vehicle and equipment, in all driving conditions.
  • Possesses sight, strength and coordination necessary to safely and effectively operate heavy and light equipment and tools.

description:

143L - Senior Data Engineer (Python/Go/Data Ingestion/Cloud) · Remote · LATAM

  • Seniority: Senior
  • English Level: B2 / C1

Get to Know Darwoft

At Darwoft, we build custom software solutions and partner with international companies to create high-impact digital products.

We are a Latin American technology company with a people-first culture, strong professional standards, and a long-term partnership mindset. We work with distributed teams, complex technical challenges, and clients whose technology has a direct impact on their businesses and users.

About the Project

We are partnering with an innovative cybersecurity company building a next-generation Identity Security and Identity Observability platform .

The product helps enterprise security teams understand how human users, service accounts, workloads, applications, and AI-driven identities access systems across cloud, SaaS, network, endpoint, and on-premise environments .

At the core of the platform is a highly data-intensive architecture that collects and analyzes large volumes of events, logs, network telemetry, identity activity, and security signals . This information is processed to identify unusual access patterns, security risks, identity blind spots, infrastructure misconfigurations, and potential threats.

The platform integrates with complex enterprise ecosystems including identity providers, cloud platforms, SASE solutions, SIEMs, endpoint security tools, network infrastructure, and security services.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Data Engineer focused on Data Ingestion, Integrations, and Collectors to become a key technical bridge between enterprise customers and the engineering organization.

This is not a traditional backend or internal data engineering position.

You'll work directly with customers to understand their infrastructure, data sources, security architecture, network topology, APIs, and workflows, then design and implement scalable mechanisms to ingest that information into the platform.

You'll combine data engineering, software engineering, solution architecture, cloud infrastructure, and technical consulting .

A major part of your mission will be building and evolving connectors and ingestion pipelines capable of integrating data from complex enterprise environments while maintaining reliability, scalability, security, and fast time-to-production.

What You'll Be Doing
  • Design, develop, and maintain production-grade data collectors, connectors, and ingestion services .
  • Integrate enterprise data sources including identity providers, cloud platforms, SASE solutions, network infrastructure, endpoints, applications, security platforms, and SIEM systems .
  • Work directly with enterprise customers to understand their environments, data flows, APIs, security requirements, and integration constraints.
  • Participate in technical onboarding processes, from initial discovery and architecture design through production deployment.
  • Design scalable ingestion architectures for processing security events, logs, identity activity, network telemetry, and other high-volume data sources .
  • Build integrations using REST APIs, cloud-native services, event-driven architectures, and modern software engineering practices .
  • Develop backend services primarily using Python and/or Go .
  • Work with SQL and NoSQL databases to store, transform, query, and analyze high-volume data.
  • Build and operate containerized services using Docker and Kubernetes .
  • Deploy and integrate solutions across AWS, Azure, and GCP environments .
  • Troubleshoot complex customer deployment and integration issues across application, infrastructure, networking, API, and data layers.
  • Optimize ingestion performance, reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency.
  • Collaborate with Solution Architects, Sales Engineering, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering teams.
  • Act as a trusted technical advisor around customer data architecture, collection strategies, security integrations, and implementation best practices.
  • Identify recurring customer requirements and transform them into reusable connectors, platform capabilities, or improvements to the core product.
  • Contribute technical insights from real-world implementations to the product roadmap.
  • Support production adoption and continuously improve time-to-value for enterprise customers.
  • Participate in occasional customer-facing technical sessions and, when necessary, onsite engagements.
What You Bring
  • 10+ years of professional Software Engineering, Data Engineering, Platform Engineering, or related experience.
  • Strong software development experience with:
    • Python
    • Go
  • Strong experience designing and consuming REST APIs .
  • Hands‑on experience building data ingestion pipelines, connector frameworks, integration platforms, or similar systems .
  • Experience integrating complex enterprise systems and third‑party platforms.
  • Solid understanding of both SQL and NoSQL databases .
  • Production experience with at least one major cloud platform:
    • AWS
    • Azure
    • GCP
  • Experience working with Docker and Kubernetes .
  • Strong understanding of Git‑based development workflows and CI/CD practices .
  • Experience designing reliable, scalable, and production‑ready distributed systems.
  • Strong debugging skills across APIs, infrastructure, networking, application services, and data pipelines.
  • Experience working directly with customers, stakeholders, or technical partners.
  • Ability to translate complex customer requirements into pragmatic technical solutions.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to operate effectively in customer‑facing technical conversations.
  • High degree of autonomy and ownership when solving ambiguous technical problems.
Highly Relevant Experience

Experience with any of the following will be especially valuable:

  • Identity and Access Management (IAM )
  • Identity Providers (IdPs )
  • Identity Security
  • Cybersecurity platforms
  • SIEM systems
  • Security telemetry
  • Network security
  • Endpoint security
  • SASE / Zero Trust environments
  • Cloud security
  • Large‑scale event processing
  • Streaming architectures
Integration Experience

Previous experience integrating APIs or data from platforms such as the following is highly valuable:

  • AWS
  • Microsoft Azure
  • Google Cloud
  • Microsoft Entra ID / Active Directory
  • Okta
  • Google Workspace
  • Duo
  • CrowdStrike
  • Zscaler
  • Palo Alto
  • Microsoft Defender
  • SIEM and security analytics platforms

Direct experience with every platform is not required. What matters is a strong track record of learning complex APIs and transforming heterogeneous enterprise data sources into reliable integrations.

Nice to Have
  • Experience with large‑scale data processing or streaming platforms.
  • Experience designing reusable connector SDKs or integration frameworks .
  • Understanding of identity‑related security concepts such as authentication, authorization, credentials, service accounts, privileged access, and non‑human identities.
  • Experience with security events, audit logs, network telemetry, or cloud activity data.
  • Familiarity with event‑driven and distributed system architectures.
  • Experience deploying AI/ML‑enabled applications.
  • Exposure to LLMs, AI agents, or AI‑powered security applications .
  • Solution Architecture or Forward Deployed Engineering experience.
  • Previous experience in cybersecurity startups or high‑growth SaaS environments.
What Success Looks Like

Success in this role will be measured by your ability to:

  • Deliver successful enterprise integrations and deployments.
  • Reduce customer time‑to‑production.
  • Build reliable and scalable ingestion solutions.
  • Improve customer adoption and technical satisfaction.
  • Resolve complex integration challenges efficiently.

title: Credit Solutions Associate I - Melbourne

title: HD-Restaurant General Mgr
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

The Restaurant General Manager (RGM) has the overall responsibility for directing the daily operations of a Hardee’s restaurant in support of the Brand Vision, Mission, and Promise while role modeling CKE’s Core Values. The RGM ensures compliance with company standards in all areas of operations including product preparation and delivery, customer service, facilities maintenance, and financial accountability. This role accomplishes these objectives by actively selecting, training, and coaching top talent to achieve key results in People, Customer, Sales, and Profit.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

May perform any or all of the following duties:

▪ Demonstrates CKE’s Core Values while building high performing employees when selecting, training, retaining, and recognizing top talent utilizing applicable tools and processes.

▪ Identifies and develops a pipeline of talent through effective succession planning tools and best practices.

▪ Executes the company’s performance management process consistently to ensure employees are set up for success and held accountable.

▪ Reinforces and follows the “Open Door” Policy with all employees.

▪ Actively monitors, demonstrates, and provides training on, all job duties of each position for any shift throughout the restaurant, including customer service, food preparation, cleaning, and stocking.

▪ Ensures proper supervision of restaurant through ongoing examination of station and customer activities.

▪ Travels between company locations to support business operations, including attending meetings and transporting product and supplies as needed.

▪ Partners with Human Resources to ensure resolution to all employee relations activities and maintain compliance with federal, state, and local requirements.

▪ Works assigned schedule to ensure that all day parts are being observed, i.e., breakfast, lunch, dinner, late night, and weekends.

▪ Drives customer-focused culture by serving as a role model in resolving customer issues and training employees to meet or exceed customer service standards.

▪ Coaches, drives excellence, and recognizes and holds the restaurant team accountable around core operational procedures through the use of company systems.

▪ Ensures that food safety standards are met through direct observation as well as follow up on food safety audit results. Ensures that restaurant management teams are properly trained through Servsafe, TAPS, or state-approved equivalent.

▪ Ensures that restaurant level plans and marketing initiatives are in place and being implemented. Partners with the District Manager to execute Local Store Marketing plans.

▪ Analyzes sales, labor, inventory, and controllables on a continual basis and takes specific corrective action to meet or achieve margin and sales growth targets.

▪ Conducts fiscal period business reviews with restaurant management team to build their capability to identify and drive tactics to close performance gaps.

▪ Shares best demonstrated practices with their team and across the district.

▪ Communicates effectively with all levels of internal and external contacts (i.e., team members, guests, vendors, visitors). Participates in company meetings, conference calls, etc.

▪ Takes the initiative, in addition to providing excellent customer service, to supervise and/or perform other duties, as needed, to keep the restaurant clean, safe, and operating efficiently.

POSITION QUALIFICATIONS/CORE COMPETENCIES

▪ High School Diploma/General Educational Development (GED) required; associate degree preferred.

▪ Minimum of three years’ experience in restaurant operation.

▪ Proficient working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.

▪ Must be able to work a flexible schedule including days, nights, and weekends.

▪ Must maintain reliable personal transportation, a valid driver’s license, and proof of insurance to travel between company locations and transport product and supplies as business needs require.

▪ Effective Communication- Consistently and effectively interacts with all members of the team; encourages open and honest communication throughout the restaurant.

▪ Customer Focused- Recognizes the customer as the first priority and creates a culture that emphasizes high standards for service and exceeding the customers’ expectations.

▪ Developing Talent- Creates an environment in which people are challenged to grow and develop; keeps the crew engaged by encouraging and rewarding personal growth.

▪ Execution Excellence- Strives to be “Best in Class” in running superior operations by analyzing costs to help ensure profitability of the restaurant. Ensures standards are upheld and procedures are followed at all times to achieve optimal results. Remains focused on the details to ensure the safety of the crew and provide a consistent customer experience.

▪ Accountability- Holds team members and themself accountable for immediate and sustained improvement if performance standards are not met, utilizing company performance management tools.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

▪ Fast paced environment working with kitchen equipment in tight quarters.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

▪ Requires constant movement in and around all areas of the restaurant.

▪ Ability to stand/walk constantly and for extended periods of time.

▪ Ability to reach overhead, bend, and stoop frequently and repetitively.

▪ Ability to work in a warm environment near grills, ovens, and vats.

▪ Able to lift 20 lbs. or more repetitively on a regular basis and up to 50 lbs. on occasion.

▪ Work with various cleaning products

THE COMPANY RETAINS THE RIGHT TO CHANGE OR ASSIGN OTHER DUTIES TO THIS POSITION AS DEEMED APPROPRIATE WITH OR WITHOUT NOTICE.

title: Director of Supplier Performance
description:
Job Location: Warren, MA; Monroe, NC

Description

POSITION DETAILS – Director, Supplier Performance

Position Summary

The Director, Supplier Performance is responsible for establishing and leading the enterprise supplier performance strategy to ensure supplier quality, delivery, capacity, responsiveness, risk management, and operational excellence support business objectives, customer commitments, and long-term growth initiatives.

This role provides strategic leadership for supplier performance management, supplier development, supply continuity, supplier risk management, and cross-functional supply chain execution across the organization. The Director serves as a key leader in developing world-class supplier capabilities, driving supply base transformation, and ensuring alignment between business objectives and supplier performance outcomes.

The Director partners closely with US NAVY Executive Leadership, Operations, Strategic Sourcing, Procurement, Engineering, Quality, and Program Management leaders to establish supplier performance expectations, governance processes, and continuous improvement strategies. This position is accountable for the overall health, resilience, and performance of the supply base and for developing organizational capabilities that support operational excellence, business growth, and customer satisfaction.

Principal Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Governance

  • Develop and execute the US NAVY Supplier Performance Management strategy aligned with corporate objectives and growth initiatives.
  • Establish supplier performance governance processes, standards, policies, and accountability mechanisms across the organization.
  • Serve as the executive leader responsible for supplier performance, supplier development, supplier risk management, and supply continuity programs.
  • Build and lead a high-performing supplier performance organization focused on operational excellence and continuous improvement.
  • Provide strategic recommendations and performance insights to executive leadership regarding supplier capabilities, risks, and opportunities.
  • Develop near-term and long-term roadmaps to improve supply base performance, resiliency, scalability, and competitiveness.

Supplier Performance Management

  • Establish and oversee US NAVY supplier scorecards, KPI frameworks, and performance monitoring systems.
  • Lead executive business reviews with strategic and critical suppliers.
  • Ensure supplier performance targets for quality, delivery, responsiveness, capacity, service, and cost are consistently achieved.
  • Drive supplier accountability through performance improvement plans, corrective actions, and recovery programs.
  • Monitor supplier performance trends and direct intervention strategies where performance risks exist.
  • Champion data-driven decision making through advanced supplier analytics and reporting systems.

Supplier Development & Capability Enhancement

  • Lead enterprise supplier development initiatives to enhance manufacturing, quality, operational, and technical capabilities.
  • Ensure strategic suppliers possess the capacity, processes, and competencies necessary to support business growth.
  • Partner with Strategic Sourcing and Engineering teams during supplier selection, qualification, and onboarding activities.
  • Direct supplier capability assessments, operational audits, and maturity evaluations.
  • Drive supplier adoption of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, automation, and continuous improvement methodologies.

Risk Management & Supply Continuity

  • Establish and maintain comprehensive supplier risk management and business continuity programs, with an emphasis on casting performance improvement.
  • Lead proactive identification and mitigation of supply disruption risks related to capacity, financial stability, geopolitical events, regulatory compliance, and operational performance.
  • Develop escalation processes and executive response strategies for critical supplier issues.
  • Ensure continuity-of-supply plans are established for strategic and sole-source suppliers.
  • Oversee supplier capacity planning and readiness activities supporting business growth and customer demand requirements.

Cross-Functional & Organizational Leadership

  • Partner with Strategic Sourcing and Procurement leadership to align sourcing strategies with supplier performance objectives.
  • Collaborate with Operations, Manufacturing and Planning teams to support production requirements and inventory objectives.
  • Work closely with Engineering and Quality organizations to improve supplier processes, product quality, and manufacturability.
  • Support new product introduction (NPI), product transfers, and supplier readiness activities.
  • Influence organizational priorities and resource allocation to support supplier performance initiatives.
  • Establish talent development strategies, succession planning, and organizational capability-building initiatives.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
  • Build strong partnerships with executive stakeholders and strategic suppliers.

CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Extensive experience leading supplier performance, supplier quality, supplier development, procurement, or supply chain organizations within complex manufacturing environments.
  • Strong executive leadership capabilities with demonstrated success building and leading high-performing teams.
  • Deep knowledge of supplier management, strategic sourcing, manufacturing operations, supply chain planning, and risk management.
  • Proven experience establishing enterprise supplier governance programs and performance management frameworks.
  • Demonstrated success leading organizational transformation and supply base performance improvement initiatives.
  • Strong financial acumen and understanding of cost structures, productivity metrics, and business drivers.
  • Advanced analytical capabilities with experience leveraging data and business intelligence tools to drive decisions.
  • Ability to influence executive leadership, customers, and strategic suppliers.
  • Strong negotiation, communication, presentation, and relationship management skills.
  • Experience managing global supplier networks and complex supply chain environments.
  • Expertise in Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, continuous improvement, and operational excellence methodologies.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and execute long-term strategic plans.
  • Strong knowledge of business continuity planning, supplier risk assessment, and compliance requirements.

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Operations Management, Business Administration, or related technical discipline required.
  • Master's Degree (MBA, Engineering Management, Operations, or related discipline) strongly preferred.
  • Minimum 15 years of progressive experience in Supply Chain, Procurement, Supplier Quality, Supplier Development, Manufacturing Operations, or related leadership roles.
  • Minimum 8 years of leadership experience managing managers, teams, or enterprise supplier performance programs.
  • Demonstrated success leading large-scale supplier performance improvements and strategic supply chain initiatives.
  • APICS/ASCM certifications, Lean Six Sigma Black Belt, Certified Supply Chain Professional (CSCP), Certified Professional in Supply Management (CPSM), or equivalent professional certifications preferred.

Other

  • U.S. Citizen

title: Transmission Operator - (Crane License Required)
description:
5 Star Electric, LLC (5 Star) is a premier full-service provider of electrical construction, maintenance, and repair services with offices in Western Kentucky and Dallas/Fort Worth, Texas. 5 Star specializes in Distribution and Transmission Power Line work, Substation, Industrial, Commercial, Streetlighting, and Fiber installations.

Position Title: Operator

Our Core Values: Guided by Safety. Focused on Communities. Powered by Care.

Essential Functions:

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

The Operators primary duty is to assist line crew or network crew members by working on the ground, handing tools and heavy materials to workers. To dig holes and pad ditches, and to perform other similar work in connection with the construction and maintenance of overhead and underground power lines. This position is the highest of a multi-step progression and is expected to know all aspects of Operator duties for the Company. Lower steps in this classification are expected to progress into all aspects of these duties. Operators are never permitted to work on energized conductors without direct/immediate supervision at all times. An Operator is also responsible for his/her own safety at all times and is expected to learn and follow all company guidelines and safety procedures. It is the responsibility of the operator to report any and all accidents to the foreman immediately and ensure the safety of his fellow crew members by following all safety guidelines.

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Passes tools to line crew or network crew members by acting as a general helper on the ground. Handles cables, conduit and other materials as directed. Glues conduits together. Assists in setting transformers.
  • Assists line crew with setting poles by shoveling or piking; fills anchor holes. Use of heavy equipment, digger derricks, backhoes, skid steers, or bucket trucks are also a necessity
  • Clears undergrowth from right-of-way by using hand tools or saws. Piles debris to clear path. Performs general clean-up of job sites following completion of work.
  • Positions reels of electric cable beside trenches and lays heavy residential underground distribution (URD) cables in ditches and pads by shoveling fine sand around cable.
  • Assists network crew top man with lowering and raising molten metals and other heavy materials to the cable splicer working below in the vault.
  • Operates roto hammer to access vaults.
  • Notifies customers of impending disruption of service while lines are under repair.
  • Flags traffic to protect employees and the public from injury.
  • May assist linemen as directed, operating jackhammer or digging bars to break concrete or rocks. May drive 3/4-ton or 1-ton pickup truck to job site or to obtain supplies.
  • Performs other duties as assigned. Job duties are subject to change as directed by management.

Success Factors:

  • Must be able to work outdoors in diverse terrain and in all weather conditions
  • Physical capabilities required to safely operate a motor vehicle and equipment, in all driving conditions.
  • Possesses sight, strength and coordination necessary to safely and effectively operate heavy and light equipment and tools.
  • Duties entail full-body exertion, strenuous lifting, carrying, pushing and pulling.
  • Must have ability for frequent travel on needed training requirements and potential for overtime including storm work.

Experience and Education:

  • High School Diploma or equivalent
  • 1 Year of Prior Equipment operating experience In a related field.
  • Additional Requirements/Licenses/Certifications:
  • Possession of, or ability to obtain, a valid State of Residence Driver License is required.
  • Must obtain a Class A CDL with Medical Examiner’s Card
  • Candidates must pass criminal and Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) background checks and pass a pre-employment drug screen.
  • Complete OSHA 10hr Safety Training Program within 60 days.
  • Successful completion of appropriate knowledge and skills examinations.
  • Compliance with Safety Performance Standards.
  • May be Employee Performance Tested to a higher level with testing and verifiable experience.
  • Completion of Critical review and recommendations from Operations, Safety/Training.
  • Must have ability for frequent travel on needed training requirements and potential for overtime including storm work.

title: Neodent Practice Growth Specialist
description:
#ChangeMakers


Ready to make an impact?

We develop, manufacture, and supply dental implants, clear aligners, instruments, CADCAM prosthetics and biomaterials for use in esthetic dentistry, tooth replacement and restoration solutions or to prevent tooth loss.

We empower our employees to perform and make an impact, to question the status quo, to drive change, to stay ahead of the competition. From the first Dental Implant in 1974 to the latest Digital Solution – we do things differently than others

We deliver innovation based on evidence. This is part of our employer culture as well as an exceptional team spirit that truly encourages diversity and a powerful “can-do” attitude.

#WeChangeDentistry every day. Be part of it.


The Practice Growth Specialist (PGS) is a customer-facing commercial role responsible for partnering with Territory Managers and strategic dental practices to identify, develop, and execute sustainable practice-growth initiatives. The PGS brings consultative business expertise into high-potential and strategic accounts to help customers grow implant treatment, improve practice efficiency, strengthen patient conversion, expand digital workflows, and maximize the value of their partnership with Neodent and Straumann Group.

The PGS works alongside the Territory Manager, who maintains ownership of the customer relationship. The role adds a deeper layer of practice-development expertise and connects customers with the people, education, technology, and resources needed to turn growth opportunities into measurable action.

Responsibilities will include but will not be limited to:

Practice Growth & Business Development

• Conduct structured practice assessments to identify growth opportunities, operational challenges, and barriers to increased implant treatment.

• Partner with practice owners and teams to develop customized growth plans with clear objectives, priorities, actions, and follow-up.

• Help practices identify opportunities to increase implant case volume, patient acceptance, referrals, and overall practice revenue.

• Provide ongoing follow-up and accountability to support execution of agreed-upon growth initiatives.

• Identify opportunities to expand utilization of Neodent and Straumann Group solutions when aligned with the practice's growth objectives.

Practice Efficiency & Workflow Optimization

• Evaluate current implant and patient workflows and identify opportunities to improve efficiency and the overall patient experience.

• Help practices address bottlenecks that may limit growth, including scheduling, treatment coordination, patient conversion, staffing, and workflow efficiency.

• Connect customers with appropriate internal and external resources, tools, education, and solutions to address identified needs.

• Support implementation of new workflows and processes across the practice team.

Digital & Technology Adoption

• Help practices understand how digital technology can improve efficiency, treatment workflows, patient experience, and practice growth.

• Partner with Digital Solutions Specialists and other internal resources to support appropriate digital adoption and implementation.

• Integrate digital solutions into broader practice-growth strategies rather than positioning technology as a standalone product.

Education & Team Development

• Identify education and training opportunities that support the practice's clinical and business growth objectives.

• Help practices develop clinical and administrative teams to better support implant treatment and patient conversion.

• Connect customers with Neodent/Straumann educational programs, clinical resources, and relevant practice-growth resources.

• Support practice teams as they implement new processes, workflows, and growth initiatives.

Strategic Account Growth & Retention

• Partner with Territory Managers to identify strategic, high-potential, underpenetrated, or at-risk accounts where practice-growth support can create meaningful impact.

• Develop deeper customer relationships by positioning Neodent and Straumann Group as long-term practice-growth partners.

• Proactively identify customer challenges and opportunities that can strengthen retention and expand the partnership.

• Support structured growth strategies across implants, digital solutions, biomaterials, education, and other relevant Straumann Group offerings.

Cross-Functional Partnership

• Collaborate closely with Territory Managers, Regional Sales Directors, Digital Solutions Specialists, Education, Marketing, and other Straumann Group partners.

• Maintain clear communication with the Territory Manager throughout assessment, planning, implementation, and follow-up.

• Coordinate the right internal resources around the customer while preserving clear account ownership and a seamless customer experience.

• Share repeatable practice-growth approaches and field learnings that can strengthen customer support across the organization.

Key Measures of Success

• Growth within supported practices and increased implant case volume.

• Improved customer retention and reduced account erosion within supported accounts.

• Expansion of relevant Neodent and Straumann Group solutions within existing customers.

• Successful execution and completion of customer practice-growth plans.

• Increased adoption of digital workflows, education, and practice-development resources where appropriate.

• Demonstrated incremental revenue and deeper customer engagement within supported accounts.

• Strong partnership and collaboration with Territory Managers and cross-functional field teams.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, healthcare, marketing, sales, or a related field; equivalent relevant professional experience may be considered
  • At least 3 years’ experience in dental, medical device, healthcare, practice management, consulting, or a related commercial environment
  • Demonstrated ability to conduct consultative business discussions with practice owners, clinicians, office managers, treatment coordinators, and other clinical or business stakeholders
  • Knowledge of business development, customer experience, practice operations, and workflow improvement principles
  • Ability to assess customer needs and develop actionable plans aligned with identified business objectives
  • Demonstrated presentation, facilitation, relationship management, and verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple customer initiatives, prioritize activities, and track follow-through in a field-based environment
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams, including sales, digital solutions, education, and marketing
  • Ability and willingness to travel regularly within the assigned territory, consistent with business requirements
  • Valid unencumbered driver’s license

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in dental implants, dental technology, or dental practice management
  • Experience supporting practice growth, patient conversion, treatment coordination, or workflow improvement
  • Experience implementing digital workflows or technology solutions in dental or healthcare settings
  • Experience in consultative selling, business coaching, or customer success, with demonstrated results related to customer or business objectives
  • Ability to evaluate business opportunities and develop customer-focused solutions that support commercial objectives

Our objective: move the customer relationship from implant supplier to long-term practice growth partner.

Salary: $110,000 - $135,000/Annually. The final pay for this position will vary based on geographic location and candidate experience relative to what the company reasonably anticipates for this position.

title: USDA Sanitarian Lead
description:
Position Summary

Under the direction of the USDA Supervisor/ Manager, the USDA Sanitarian Lead is responsible for leading sanitation activities in the USDA room, equipment and designated areas of the facility. This role ensures sanitation procedures are completed safely, efficiently, and in compliance with USDA regulations, company standards, and customer requirements. Assist the Supervisor/Manager in ensuring standards are met or exceeded and all personnel actions are completed in a timely manner. The Lead supports audit readiness, employee training, documentation accuracy, and daily sanitation team coordination.

Required Qualifications

  • Ability to follow verbal and written instructions.
  • Ability to read and write in English and perform basic math functions.
  • Ability to understand work processes, methods and use of equipment.
  • Knowledge of chemical mixing process.
  • Ability to lead others in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

Desired Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Strong communication skills.
  • USDA Inspection experience.
  • Bilingual Spanish/English a plus.
  • USDA Sanitation experience, at least 1 full year, in manufacturing setting.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and support sanitation team members to ensure work is completed safely “Safety First, on time, and to standard.

  • Ensure all safety rules, SSOPs, and sanitation procedures are followed at all times.
  • Oversee cleaning and sanitizing of the USDA room, equipment, and other assigned facility areas.
  • Perform sanitation duties as set forth in Latitude 36 Foods SSOP’s and in compliance with USDA/FDA regulations and guidelines.
  • Follow guidelines as set forth by Supervisor and the Manufacturer for use of cleaning equipment when performing your duties
  • Test and record sanitizer strength on the log sheet outside of the room.
  • Detecting and eliminating residue can affect the safety and quality of the product.
  • Ability to follow lockout/tagout procedures to guarantee equipment remains turned off during cleaning labor to follow safety precaution.
  • Report any mechanical problems to the supervisor.
  • Verify chemical mixing, chemical concentrations, and proper use of cleaning materials.
  • Ensures daily documentation paperwork is completed properly, reviewed and submitted on time.
  • Ensures that production area is always “audit ready”.
  • Communicate sanitation updates, revisions, and food safety requirements sanitation crew. Help monitor attendance, and other assigned personnel-related tasks.
  • Assist with training new hires and support ongoing team development.
  • Complete all annual training for the sanitation team.
  • Maintain strong communication across departments to support production and sanitation needs.
  • Performs other duties as assigned by leadership.

Physical Requirements

  • Work area temperatures are between 34- and 40-degrees Fahrenheit.
  • Frequent exposure to wet and humid conditions during sanitation.
  • Must be able to lift and move up to 50 pounds frequently.
  • Frequent standing, walking, bending, twisting, lifting, climbing and moving heavy items.
  • Ability to work with cleaning materials, chemicals and sanitation equipment.
  • Normal visual and hearing acuity required.

title: Senior Director, Deputy Chief Information Security Officer
description:
Are you ready to unlock your potential?

At Straumann Group we’re on an exciting journey of growth, innovation, and impact - driven by our mission to improve oral health and transform millions of lives worldwide. United by purpose, we bring our best selves to work every day, embracing a high-performance, player-learner culture that inspires collaboration, curiosity, and ambition. Here, you’ll have the opportunity to take charge of your own career, harnessing your skills, passion, and enthusiasm for learning to continually grow and progress. Together, we’re not just shaping brighter smiles, we’re unlocking the potential of people everywhere, including our own.

Introduction:

As Senior Director, Deputy Chief Information Security Officer, you will be the operational partner to the Chief Information Security Officer and act on their behalf during periods of delegated absence.

This role has a clear focus: strengthening application and product security across digital products, platforms and connected medical devices, while supporting the execution of Straumann Group’s wider cybersecurity strategy.

Your Role:

  • You will lead and mature the application and product security function, embedding secure software development practices across architecture, design, development, testing, release and post-market activities.
  • You will define and govern secure software development lifecycle requirements, security architecture reviews, threat modelling, application security testing, vulnerability remediation, software supply-chain security, SBOMs and third-party component governance.
  • You will oversee product vulnerability management, coordinated vulnerability disclosure and post-market cybersecurity monitoring, ensuring product-security requirements become practical engineering controls.
  • Working closely with Product Development, Engineering, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Enterprise Architecture, Digital Trust & Assurance, Security Operations, Legal, Privacy and strategic technology partners, you will help ensure security risks, exceptions and remediation decisions are clearly documented and well governed.
  • You will also support the CISO in translating cybersecurity strategy into measurable execution, lead selected cross-functional security priorities, resolve issues across product and technology teams, and represent the CISO in internal or external forums when delegated.

Your Profile:

  • You bring significant leadership experience in cybersecurity, application security, product security or software security.
  • You have built or led application and product security capabilities in a complex enterprise environment.
  • You understand secure software development, DevSecOps, modern application architectures, cloud-native applications, APIs, identity, CI/CD pipelines and software supply-chain security.
  • You have experience with threat modelling, security architecture, penetration testing and vulnerability management.
  • You are confident engaging senior stakeholders, auditors and regulators, and can translate cybersecurity and regulatory requirements into practical, risk-based controls.
  • Experience in regulated environments is important; medical devices, healthcare, life sciences or manufacturing experience would be an advantage.
  • Knowledge of medical-device cybersecurity and secure product lifecycle requirements is strongly preferred.
  • Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CSSLP, CCSP or equivalent are welcome, but not mandatory.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • You combine technical credibility with senior leadership judgement. You can challenge constructively, influence across organisational boundaries and focus teams on material product and software-security risks.
  • You are effective at turning complex security and regulatory topics into clear decisions, practical actions and measurable outcomes.
